documents.title: Fix ECONNRESET in webhook retry loop
turns: The webhook worker keeps dying with ECONNRESET when the partner endpoint drops the socket.
The retry loop in retry_with_backoff catches TimeoutError only, so ECONNRESET escapes and kills the worker.
Catch the connection reset as well and keep the backoff.
Done: retry_with_backoff now retries on ECONNRESET with the same jittered backoff.
Add a test that simulates the reset.
